nextLayerName: Workload data, storage locality, network dependencies, and end-to-end reproducibility
reason: Integrated the observation-only WorkloadProfile capability into ZBookPerf with exact executable-name filtering, stable PID-plus-start-time identity, CPU/I/O/memory/thread/handle/lifecycle distributions, access-aware null handling, monotonic intervals, observer calibration, and automated tests. The high-overhead CIM prototype was rejected and replaced with direct documented process APIs; the final Explorer baseline measured 10 of 10 intervals with a 19.303 ms median snapshot cost. No process or Windows setting changed and no performance-gain claim was made.
